From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Busker's harmonica, Dog tags, Mixtape, Search locket, Seed packet. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. They found a deer this morning. Inside out. Not eaten — unmade. Like something was trying to understand how it worked. It didn't finish.
